jobs.title: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy - Engineer - LOCA and Containment Analysis
jobs.description:
As a contributing member of the LOCA, Containment & Stability Analysis Team, you will perform plant thermal-hydraulic safety analysis with two-phase thermal hydraulic analysis techniques. You will support reload and design applications for Boiling Water Reactor (BWR) plants, including currently operating BWR plants as well as new plants (BWRX, Natrium) operating or planned worldwide.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Perform plant thermal hydraulic evaluations and analyses in the areas of ECCS LOCA, Containment, HELB, Fire Safe Shutdown, Annulus Pressurization Loads, and RIPD analyses.
* General expertise in two-phase thermal hydraulic analysis techniques.
* Take responsibility for fuel project activities including reload analyses, methods implementation, power uprates, new fuel introductions, and safety analysis support for emergent fuel issues.
* Perform in cross-disciplinary settings, engaged with interfacing teams responsible for mechanical design, core design, licensing, systems design, or other affiliated organizations to find optimum customer solutions.
* Prepare, document and present technical data to internal/external customers.
* Provide technical mentoring to support team development and knowledge management, including procedure development and adherence.
* Develop/deliver training course offerings in support of external commercial requests, as well as for internal audiences for knowledge management, and knowledge capture and transfer.
* Lead team process improvements to drive speed and simplification.
* Ensure work is performed with high quality in accordance with regulatory rules and regulations, customer requirements, and business quality assurance standards.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Discipline (Nuclear, Mechanical, Chemical, or similar) from an accredited college or university.
* Experience in T-H Nuclear Plant Safety Analysis.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience in ECCS LOCA, Containment, HELB, Fire Safe Shutdown, Annulus Pressurization Loads, and Reactor Internals Pressure Difference analyses.
* M.S. Degree in Nuclear Engineering with experience in T/H modeling as applied to nuclear reactor systems.
* Experience with BWR technology ECCS LOCA and Containment analysis to support applicable regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of reactor licensing requirements.
* Experience with BWR/PWR T-H systems codes such as TRACG, RELAP & TRACE.
* Experience in Best Estimate methodology development (e.g., TRACG LOCA).
* Experience with Best Estimate and CSAU applications.
* Programming experience such as C#, FORTRAN, or PYTHON.
* Demonstrated high energy and the ability to energize others.
* Honest and straightforward with a high level of personal integrity.
* Work easily and communicate effectively within a team environment.
* Seeks simple solutions to complex problems.
* Detail oriented and accountable for completion of work and assignments.
* Clearly and confidently communicates based on deep understanding.
* Communicates in an open, candid, clear, and consistent manner.
* Legacy of delivering on commitments; tenacious, with a proven track record of overcoming obstacles. Ability to achieve stretch targets.
  

  

**Additional Information**

* GE Vernova Engineering Innovation Center (EIC) in Warsaw, Poland is an integral part of the global engineering structure of GE Vernova. The site was officially founded in 2007, as GE Gas Power focused engineering organization. Currently the site extends engineering activities for GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy in Poland.
* GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
* *GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in Poland for this opening. This position requires access to and/or use of information subject to U.S. Export Control Laws, which mandate all citizenships be from the U.S. Department of Energy’s List of Generally Authorized Countries (10 CFR Part 810 Appendix A); otherwise a specific authorization from the U.S. Department of Energy will be required. More information can be found here:* *https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/10-cfr-part-810*

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

jobs.title: Technical Engineer/Technical Specialist
jobs.description:
Technical Engineer / Technical Specialist

**Location:** AMK  
**Working Hours:** Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM  
**Salary:** $2,400 - $4,000

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a **Technical Engineer / Technical Specialist with AI competencies** to support the development, implementation and maintenance of digital learning applications, including Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other learning technology platforms.

The role combines software development, system integration and AI technologies to enhance learning platforms, improve user experience, personalise learning pathways and strengthen platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering skills, experience with learning technology platforms and practical knowledge of AI tools and technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Learning Application Development

* Develop, customise and maintain Learning Management Systems (LMS) and other digital learning platforms.
* Support the implementation, configuration and deployment of learning technologies.
* Ensure applications are scalable, secure and aligned with established system architecture standards.

AI Integration & Development

* Design and integrate AI-powered features such as recommendation engines, chatbots and adaptive learning tools.
* Integrate AI frameworks and APIs to support learning analytics, learner engagement and personalisation.
* Explore and implement AI-driven solutions for content discovery, learner support and performance tracking.

System Integration

* Integrate LMS platforms with enterprise systems such as HR, authentication and analytics platforms using APIs and middleware.
* Support integration between different applications and systems.
* Ensure compatibility with e-learning standards such as SCORM, xAPI and LTI.

Testing & Optimisation

* Conduct system testing, debugging and performance optimisation for application and AI components.
* Monitor platform performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during implementation and deployment.

Collaboration

* Work closely with instructional designers, project managers and product teams to translate learning requirements into technical solutions.
* Collaborate with data engineers and AI specialists to implement machine learning models and intelligent features.
* Work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Support

* Maintain technical documentation covering system architecture, integrations and AI components.
* Provide technical troubleshooting and support during system implementation and deployment.
* Ensure system configurations and integrations are properly documented and maintained.

**Skills & Experience**

* Experience in software development using languages such as **Python, JavaScript, C# or Java**.
* Good knowledge of web technologies including **HTML5, CSS and REST APIs**.
* Familiarity with microservices architecture.
* Experience working with **Learning Management Systems (LMS)** or digital learning platforms.
* Hands-on experience with relational databases such as **Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or PostgreSQL**.

AI & Data

* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks such as **TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn**.
* Experience integrating AI APIs or services, including NLP, recommendation engines or chatbot frameworks.
* Understanding of learning analytics, data processing and AI-driven personalisation.

Systems & Integration

* Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs or middleware.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure or Google Cloud**.
* Familiarity with **SCORM, xAPI, LTI** or other digital learning standards will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of system administration, including user access management, data backup and security practices in cloud environments.

Other Skills

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good attention to detail when handling configurations, customisations and system integrations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional project teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications in AI, cloud platforms, software engineering or LMS technologies will be an advantage.
* Experience working with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud in learning technology environments.
* Experience with SCORM, xAPI or Tin Can API for learning activity tracking and reporting.
* Knowledge of data security practices, particularly for sensitive learning and employee data.
* Experience working with cloud-based learning platforms.

Pay: $2,600.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: R&D Internship Software AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Môtiers (Switzerland)

100%

ETEL is a worldwide leader in the development and manufacturing of high-performance motion control components and high-end mechatronic motion systems based in Môtiers, and 100% dedicated to direct drive solutions. We currently call upon a growing diversity of skills which take part in the exciting adventure of our international activity. Contribute to our growth!

##### **We are looking for**

A curious, methodical, and organized person with a passion for AI technologies, software development, and developer productivity tools. A team player with strong analytical skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with engineers across multiple disciplines.

##### **We offer you**

* A 6-month internship in an open and dynamic midsize employer within an international environment, a modern and innovative high-tech company.
* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI assistants and developer productivity solutions used by engineers across the organization.
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft AI technologies, and other AI custom software development.
* Exposure to modern development tools and practices including Git, CI/CD, Azure, VS Code, and so on…

##### **Your tasks**

Under the guidance of experienced developers and aligned with your skills, interests, and business needs, you will contribute to:

* **AI Assistant Development** – Maintain and enhance the Comet 5 Assistant through new features, workflow optimization, and user experience improvements.
* **Custom AI Solutions** – Develop AI-based tools using GETAI technologies to automate engineering tasks and support business processes.
* **Developer Tools Engineering** – Enhance the Kilo development environment and associate VS Code extensions for ETEL software development.
* **Integration & Automation** – Embed AI capabilities into development workflows to improve productivity and software quality.
* **Testing & Quality Assurance** – Implement automated testing, validate solutions, and ensure reliability and maintainability.
* **Documentation & Collaboration** – Produce technical documentation and work closely with engineering teams to identify and implement process improvements.

##### **Your profile**

* Bachelor / Master in computer science, electronics, mechanical engineering or similar fields.
* Solid programming skills in C#, C++, Python; comfortable with Bash/PowerShell scripting.
* Familiarity with AI related frameworks (Agent Framework, PyTorch, HuggingFace) and principles of vector search engines.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), and containerisation (Docker).
* Fluent English; French a plus.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Líder de Equipo de Ingeniería de Software
jobs.description:
**Descripción del empleo**

* Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y promover la innovación en productos y procesos de desarrollo.

**¿Qué queremos saber sobre ti?**

**Formación y base técnica**

* Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o titulación equivalente.
* Se valorará formación de posgrado en ingeniería de software o gestión tecnológica.

**Experiencia profesional**

* Más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
* Al menos 2 años liderando equipos técnicos y proyectos de desarrollo.

**Conocimientos técnicos valorados**

* Desarrollo de aplicaciones de escritorio con tecnologías como C#, .NET, C++ o Python.
* Diseño de arquitecturas software y desarrollo de productos.
* Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL.
* Herramientas DevOps, control de versiones y entornos CI/CD.
* Metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).

**Competencias clave**

* Liderazgo técnico y gestión de personas.
* Orientación a resultados y visión de producto.
* Capacidad analítica y resolución de problemas.
* Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en entornos multidisciplinares.
* Innovación y aprendizaje continuo.

**Idiomas**

* Español: nativo
* Inglés: nivel alto (oral y escrito).

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* Flexibilidad horaria.
* Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante el verano.
* Medidas de conciliación para favorecer el equilibrio entre la vida personal y profesional.
* La oportunidad de liderar un equipo clave en el desarrollo de productos tecnológicos innovadores.

If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.*

*#LI-LF1*

Cuando nuestra gente se une, ampliamos lo posible mejorando continuamente lo que hacemos y cómo lo hacemos — para nuestros clientes y entre nosotros.  
Si estás preparado para revolucionar la manera en que el mundo se mueve para las generaciones futuras, Wabtec es tu sitio.

Estamos construyendo una cultura donde el liderazgo, la inclusión y tu perspectiva única impulsan el progreso.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de una combinación de experiencias y procedencias.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
DESCRIPCIóN

¡Capitole sigue creciendo - y queremos que formes parte del viaje!

Estamos buscando un/a **Senior Back End Engineer con +5** años de experiencia para unirse a nuestro increíble equipo.

**Funciones:**

  

**Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / Azure / APIs / Integración de Sistemas)**

Formar parte del equipo de ingeniería responsable del diseño, desarrollo y evolución del backend de la plataforma digital, incluyendo APIs de negocio, integraciones con sistemas corporativos y terceros, gestión de identidad, persistencia de datos y despliegue cloud sobre Microsoft Azure.

El rol tendrá responsabilidad directa sobre la construcción de servicios backend escalables, seguros y de alta disponibilidad, trabajando principalmente con Node.js y TypeScript, en una arquitectura basada en APIs, contenedores, PostgreSQL, Redis y Azure.

**Desarrollo Backend**

* Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener servicios backend utilizando Node.js y TypeScript.
* Diseñar y desarrollar APIs REST seguras, escalables y orientadas a dominio.
* Implementar lógica de negocio y reglas funcionales de la plataforma.
* Garantizar la calidad, mantenibilidad y rendimiento del código.
* Participar en revisiones de código y definición de estándares técnicos.

**Integración de Sistemas**

* Integrar la plataforma con sistemas corporativos internos y servicios de terceros mediante APIs REST.
* Desarrollar adaptadores y componentes de integración entre diferentes plataformas tecnológicas.
* Implementar mecanismos de resiliencia:

o Retry

o Circuit Breaker

o Timeout Management

o Rate Limiting

o Caching

* Participar en el análisis y diseño de contratos API.

**Seguridad e Identidad**

* Implementar mecanismos de autenticación y autorización basados en:

o OAuth 2.0

o OpenID Connect (OIDC)

o JWT

* Integrar la plataforma con proveedores de identidad corporativos.
* Gestionar secretos y credenciales mediante Azure Key Vault.
* Aplicar principios Secure by Design.

**Cloud & DevOps**

* Desarrollar soluciones desplegadas sobre Microsoft Azure.
* Participar en la definición de arquitecturas cloud escalables y altamente disponibles.
* Colaborar en pipelines CI/CD y procesos de despliegue automatizado.
* Participar en la monitorización y resolución de incidencias productivas.

**Datos y Persistencia**

* Diseñar modelos de datos relacionales sobre PostgreSQL.
* Optimizar consultas y rendimiento de bases de datos.
* Diseñar estrategias de caché utilizando Redis.
* Participar en estrategias de escalabilidad y alta disponibilidad.

**Requisitos Imprescindibles:**

  

**Experiencia**

* Más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo backend.
* Más de 3 años desarrollando soluciones productivas con Node.js.
* Experiencia en diseño e implementación de APIs REST.
* Experiencia integrando sistemas corporativos mediante APIs.
* Experiencia trabajando en entornos cloud.

**Tecnologías Backend**

* Node.js
* TypeScript
* Express.js y/o NestJS
* REST APIs
* OpenAPI / Swagger
* PostgreSQL
* Redis
* Git

**Arquitectura**

* Arquitecturas orientadas a servicios.
* Diseño API First.
* Clean Architecture.
* Principios SOLID.
* Domain Driven Design (DDD).
* Diseño de integraciones entre sistemas.

**Seguridad**

* OAuth 2.0

* JWT

**Cloud**

**Conocimientos Deseables:**

  

**Ecosistema Microsoft**

* C#

Se valorará especialmente experiencia en integración y mantenimiento de soluciones backend desarrolladas sobre tecnologías Microsoft .NET.

Buscamos un desarrollador senior con sólida experiencia en Node.js, APIs e integración de sistemas, acostumbrado a trabajar en entornos cloud sobre Azure y con capacidad para diseñar soluciones backend empresariales escalables, seguras y mantenibles.
